title: Marketing Autoresearch: turn a brief into evidence, then stop before publish
audience: Engineering managers, applied-AI leaders, and forward-deployed hiring teams evaluating trustworthy technical execution.
promise: Start with a real public portfolio decision brief, preserve source and uncertainty boundaries, and make the human publication gate visible before any external action.
story: A real public portfolio question asks which AI Showcase lane should be foregrounded next and what proof gap limits trust.
The brief names three candidate lanes, an allowed source registry, evidence rules, exclusions, and a one-page report contract.
The privacy review excludes client work, private paths, credentials, raw provider payloads, outreach, spend, and publication.
The current no-live probe is report-only with zero external mutations, but it stops because observations are missing and the runtime has no brief-aware source-to-claim receipt.
The public candidate ends at a locked handoff: a future report and refusal receipt must be produced by the owning runtime before release claims are made.
verified_locally: MA-1 is a real public-safe portfolio maintenance question, not an invented market result.
The brief carries three candidate lanes, three approved logical source entries, source-to-claim rules, stop conditions, and a blocked_pending_human_review publication state.
Privacy review passes with conditions and explicitly excludes BidCamp, Soundscape, private data, credentials, absolute paths, and external actions.
The isolated no-live probe records report-only execution and zero external mutations while preserving the missing-observation blocker.
The synthetic appendix exercises private-source, unlinked-claim, and publish-request refusals without becoming market evidence.
The local packet includes a candidate no-auth source page and reviewed 1600x900 preview.
open_gates: Add a brief-aware run input and source-to-claim receipt owned by marketing-autoresearch (or an explicitly owned adapter with the same redaction rules).
Rerun MA-2 with current retrieval dates, allowed-source checks, uncertainty labels, and a traceable report artifact.
Capture a real publication refusal receipt and external-state readback; the local policy is not a runtime receipt.
Verify a hosted no-auth case URL and external destination readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a real public-safe brief, privacy boundary, fail-closed no-live probe, synthetic refusal appendix, and local candidate materials. It does not claim audience demand, a winning lane, research quality, a report result, runtime publication refusal, hosting, or publication.
